row.evidence: Vanta's pricing comparison table marks SCIM as not included on Essentials and Plus and included on Professional and Enterprise; Vanta's help centre says SCIM 'may require an upgrade or add-on'.
row.notes: Still gated, but the SCIM plan moved down from Enterprise to Professional (pricing comparison table, read from markup). Plans are now Essentials, Plus, Professional and Enterprise, all quote-only; June's Core/Growth/Scale tiers and the ~$10K/yr figures have no first-party source and were dropped. SSO, Event logs and the Vanta API are on all plans. SCIM runs through WorkOS (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, JumpCloud) and syncs first/last name, email and RBAC role; deprovisioning deactivates the Vanta user only. Okta OIN app is marked SCIM-capable, but Vanta says to use a custom SCIM app for Okta.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Plan checkmarks read from the comparison-table markup: SSO, Event logs and Vanta API are checked on all four plans; SCIM is an X on Essentials and Plus and checked on Professional and Enterprise.

auth.token_source: Vanta Admin Portal (WorkOS), which shows the SCIM API Endpoint and Bearer Token

deprovision.data_retained: Only the Vanta user account is deprovisioned; the personnel record on the People page is unaffected. Re-provisioning reactivates the existing user when Vanta can find a unique match.

core: rbac_role_id (custom attribute in the core namespace)

custom.how: Map an IdP attribute (Okta custom attribute in namespace urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User, or Entra app roles via userType) to Vanta's rbac_role_id.

group: IdP groups mapped to Vanta teams (name, membership)

roles.how: rbac_role_id attribute carries the Vanta role ID (found on the Roles tab of the User Provisioning section); JumpCloud cannot send custom attributes, so Vanta maps JumpCloud groups to built-in role IDs by request.

limitations.text: SCIM runs through WorkOS as a middle layer; the endpoint and token come from the WorkOS Admin Portal, not a documented Vanta SCIM API.
Okta: use a custom SCIM app (SCIM 2.0 Test App) because the Vanta OIN SSO app does not support Push Groups / SCIM per Vanta's help centre.
JumpCloud needs SAML configured first and cannot sync custom roles.
SCIM-managed team names and membership cannot be edited in Vanta, and teams require the Collaborator role or higher.

capabilities.notes: User endpoints are read-only (list active users, get user). Groups and people (personnel records) can be managed, and people can be offboarded, but that acts on personnel records, not Vanta login accounts.

endpoints.purpose: Add a person to a group
Remove a person from a group

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked, but Vanta's help centre says to use a custom SCIM app (SCIM 2.0 Test App) until the Vanta OIN app supports SCIM.

entra.notes: Vanta documents Entra SCIM via WorkOS on an existing SAML app; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (404).

google.notes: Google Workspace is listed among SCIM-supported IdPs via WorkOS; mechanism not documented.

fallbacks.other_sync: Personnel auto-provisioning: personnel records synced from IdP/HRIS integrations to the People page create linked user accounts with the Employee role and deactivate them when the record is terminated.

citations.quote: SCIM lets you manage Vanta login access directly from your identity provider (IdP). When SCIM is enabled, your IdP controls who has a Vanta account and what role they're assigned—provisioning, deprovisioning, and updating roles for user accounts automatically as your team changes.
